segments.caption: From a first-person perspective on a motocross bike, the rider prepares for a stunt, positioned at the start of a dirt ramp with a Red Bull can perched precariously on a parked car ahead. Spectators watch from the sidelines as the rider waits, the scene charged with anticipation before the jump.

A first-person view from a mountain biker’s helmet camera captures the thrilling descent of a Red Bull-sponsored downhill race through a narrow, urban street lined with spectators, barriers, and branded signage, as the rider navigates a steep, sunlit course with increasing speed and momentum.
A first-person view from a motorcycle speeding up a steep, narrow urban street, passing spectators and safety barriers, with a Red Bull logo visible on the bike’s front.

A motocross rider, viewed from a helmet-mounted camera, speeds down a narrow urban street lined with spectators, then launches off a steep ramp into a dirt landing area, showcasing an adrenaline-fueled stunt in a Red Bull event.

A motocross rider, viewed from a helmet-mounted camera, speeds down a narrow, steep, dirt-lined street flanked by crowds of spectators behind makeshift barriers, navigating a challenging urban downhill course.
A first-person view from a mountain bike rider speeding down a narrow, steep urban street lined with spectators behind barriers, navigating a technical descent with a Red Bull-branded bike.
A motorcyclist races down a steep, narrow street, navigating a high-speed descent that includes a dramatic jump over a gap, landing smoothly and continuing at high speed through the urban course.

A first-person view from a speeding downhill mountain bike, racing through a street course lined with spectators, barriers, and cones, as the rider navigates turns and approaches a pedestrian crossing.

A first-person perspective from a motorcycle racer speeding through a tight, urban street course lined with cheering crowds and branded banners, navigating sharp turns and obstacles as part of a high-energy Red Bull event.
A first-person view from a motorcycle speeding through a narrow, cobblestoned street lined with spectators, with a prominent Red Bull logo visible on the bike's front.
A mountain biker races down a narrow, sunlit urban street, the Red Bull logo on their helmet visible as they speed past crowds of spectators lining the sidewalks and alleyways.

A first-person view from a speeding downhill mountain bike, racing through a narrow, sunlit street lined with cheering spectators behind barriers, with vibrant graffiti and buildings flanking the route.
A first-person view from a speeding rally car, likely in a Red Bull event, races down a narrow, crowd-lined street, navigating tight turns and obstacles as spectators cheer from behind barriers.

A first-person view from a mountain bike racer speeding down a narrow, winding urban street lined with spectators behind barriers, the Red Bull logo visible on the handlebars as the rider navigates the course.
A first-person view from a motorcycle speeding down a narrow, crowded street lined with spectators behind barriers, with the Red Bull logo visible on the bike’s front.

A first-person view from a BMX rider’s helmet-mounted camera captures the high-energy, crowd-filled streets of a Red Bull-sponsored urban bike event. The rider navigates through a narrow course lined with spectators, photographers, and event staff, with the Red Bull logo visible on the bike’s handlebars. The scene is bright and dynamic, showcasing the rider’s perspective as they weave through the urban environment, passing barriers, buildings, and a parked ambulance, all while the crowd watches
